mn44:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
mn44:1.3: Atha kho Visākho upāsako yena Dhammadinnā bhikkhunī ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Dhammadinnaṃ bhikkhuniṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Visākho upāsako Dhammadinnaṃ bhikkhuniṃ etad-avoca:
mn44:2.2: Katamo nu kho ayye sakkāyo vutto Bhagavatā ti. --
mn44:2.3: Pañca kho ime āvuso Visākha upādānakkhandhā sakkāyo vutto Bhagavatā,
mn44:2.4: seyyathīdaṃ rūpupādānakkhandho vedanupādānakkhandho saññupādānakkhandho saṅkhārupādānakkhandho viññāṇupādānakkhandho.
mn44:2.5: Ime kho āvuso Visākha pañc' upādānakkhandhā sakkāyo vutto Bhagavatā ti.
mn44:2.6: Sādh' ayye ti kho Visākho upāsako Dhammadinnāya bhikkhuniyā bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā Dhammadinnaṃ bhikkhuniṃ uttariṃ pañhaṃ apucchi:
mn44:3.2: Katamo nu kho ayye sakkāyasamudayo vutto Bhagavatā ti. --
mn44:3.3: Yā 'yaṃ āvuso Visākha taṇhā ponobhavikā nandirāgasahagatā tatratatrābhinandinī, seyyathīdaṃ
mn44:3.5: ayaṃ kho āvuso Visākha sakkāyasamudayo vutto Bhagavatā ti. --
mn44:4.2: Katamo nu kho ayye sakkāyanirodho vutto Bhagavatā ti. --
mn44:4.3: Yo kho āvuso Visākha tassā yeva taṇhāya asesavirāganirodho cāgo paṭinissaggo mutti anālayo,
mn44:4.4: ayaṃ kho āvuso Visākha sakkāyanirodho vutto Bhagavatā ti.
mn44:5.1: -Sakkāyanirodhagāminī paṭipadā sakkāyanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti ayye vuccati.
mn44:5.2: Katamā nu kho ayye sakkāyanirodhagāminī paṭipadā vuttā Bhagavatā ti. --
mn44:5.3: Ayam-eva kho āvuso Visākha ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo sakkāyanirodhagāminī paṭipadā vuttā Bhagavatā, seyyathīdaṃ
mn44:5.4: sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhīti. --
mn44:6.1: Tañ-ñeva nu kho ayye upādānaṃ te pañc' upādānakkhandhā, udāhu aññatra pañcah' upādānakkhandhehi upādānan-ti. --
mn44:6.2: Na kho āvuso Visākha tañ-ñeva upādānaṃ te pañc' upādānakkhandhā, na pi aññatra pañcah' upādānakkhandhehi upādānaṃ. \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn44:6.3: Yo kho āvuso Visākha pañcas' upādānakkhandhesu chandarāgo taṃ tattha upādānan-ti.
mn44:7.2: Idh' āvuso Visākha assutavā puthujjano ariyānaṃ adassāvī ariyadhammassa akovido ariyadhamme avinīto, sappurisānaṃ adassāvī sappurisadhammassa akovido sappurisadhamme avinīto,
mn44:7.3: rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā rūpaṃ, rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ;
mn44:7.4: vedanaṃ attato samanupassati. vedanāvantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā vedanaṃ, vedanāya yā attānaṃ;
mn44:7.5: saññaṃ attato samanupassati, saññāvantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā saññaṃ, saññāya vā attānaṃ;
mn44:7.6: saṅkhāre attato samanupassati, saṅkhāravantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā saṅkhāre. saṅkhāresu vā attānaṃ;
mn44:7.7: viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati, viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
mn44:7.8: Evaṃ kho āvuso Visākha sakkāyadiṭṭhi hotīti. --
mn44:8.1: Kathaṃ pan' ayye sakkāyadiṭṭhi na hotīti. --
mn44:8.2: Idh' āvuso Visākha sutavā ariyasāvako ariyānam dassāvī ariyadhammassa kovido ariyadhamme suvinīto, sappurisānaṃ dassāvī sappurisadhammassa kovido sappurisadhamme suvinīto,
mn44:8.3: na rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, na rūpavantaṃ attānaṃ, na attani rūpaṃ, na rāpasmiṃ attānaṃ;
mn44:8.4: na vedanaṃ attato samanupassati, na vedanāvantaṃ attānaṃ, na attani vedanaṃ, na vedanāya attānaṃ;
mn44:8.5: na saññaṃ attato samanupassati, na saññāvantaṃ attānaṃ, na attani saññaṃ, na saññāya attānaṃ;
mn44:8.6: na saṅkhāre attato samanupassati, na saṅkhāravantaṃ attānaṃ, na attani saṅkhāre, na saṅkhāresu attānaṃ;
mn44:8.7: na viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati, na viññāṇavantaṃ attānaṃ, na attani viññāṇaṃ, na viññāṇasmiṃ attānaṃ.
mn44:8.8: Evaṃ kho āvuso Visākha sakkāyadiṭṭhi na hotīti.
mn44:9.1: Katamo pan' ayye ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo ti. --
mn44:9.2: Ayameva kho āvuso Visākha ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo, seyyathīdaṃ
mn44:9.3: sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhīti.
mn44:10.1: -Ariyo pan' ayye aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo saṅkhato udāhu asaṅkhato ti. --
mn44:10.2: Ariyo kho āvuso Visākha aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo saṅkhato ti. \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ --
mn44:11.1: Ariyena nu kho ayye aṭṭhaṅgikena maggena tayo khandhā saṅgahītā, udāhu tīhi khandhehi ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo saṅgahīto ti. --
mn44:11.2: Na kho āvuso Visākha ariyena aṭṭhaṅgikena maggena tayo khandhā saṅgahītā, tīhi ca kho āvuso Visākha khandhehi ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo saṅgahīto.
mn44:11.3: Yā c' āvuso Visākha sammāvācā yo ca sammākammanto yo ca sammāājīvo, ime dhammā sīlakkhandhe saṅgahītā;
mn44:11.4: yo ca sammāvāyāmo yā ca sammāsati yo ca sammāsamādhi, ime dhammā samādhikkhandhe saṅgahītā;
mn44:11.5: yā ca sammādiṭṭhi yo ca sammāsaṅkappo, ime dhammā paññākkhandhe saṅgahītā ti. --
mn44:12.1: Katamo pan' ayye samādhi, katame samādhinimittā, katame samādhiparikkhārā, katamā samādhibhāvanā ti.
mn44:12.2: -Yā kho āvuso Visākha cittassa ekaggatā ayaṃ samādhi,
mn44:12.5: yā tesaṃ yeva dhammānaṃ āsevanā bhāvanā bahulīkammaṃ ayaṃ tattha samādhibhāvanā ti.
mn44:14.1: -Katamo pan' ayye kāyasaṅkhāro, katamo vacīsaṅkhāro, katamo cittasaṅkhāro ti. --
mn44:14.2: Assāsapassāsā kho āvuso Visākha kāyasaṅkhāro, vitakkavicārā vacīsaṅkhāro, saññā ca vedanā ca cittasaṅkhāro ti. --
mn44:15.1: Kasmā pan' ayye assāsapassāsā kāyasaṅkhāro, kasmā vitakkavicārā vacīsaṅkhāro, kasmā saññā ca vedanā ca cittasaṅkhāro ti. --
mn44:15.2: Assāsapassāsā kho āvuso Visākha kāyikā ete dhammā kāyapaṭibaddhā, tasmā assāsapassāsā kāyasaṅkhāro.
mn44:15.3: Pubbe kho āvuso Visākha vitakketvā vicāretvā pacchā vācaṃ bhindati, tasmā vitakkavicārā vacīsaṅkhāro.
mn44:15.4: Saññā ca vedanā ca cetasikā ete dhammā cittapaṭibaddhā, tasmā saññā ca vedanā ca cittasaṅkhāro ti. Kathañ-
mn44:16.2: Na kho āvuso Visākha saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjantassa bhikkhuno evaṃ hoti:
mn44:16.3: ahaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjissan-ti vā, ahaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjāmīti vā, ahaṃ saññāvedayitanirodham samāpanno ti vā,
mn44:16.4: atha khvāssa pubbe va tathā cittaṃ bhāvitaṃ hoti yan-taṃ tathattāya upanetīti. --
mn44:17.1: Saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjantassa pan' ayye bhikkhuno katame dhammā paṭhamaṃ nirujjhanti, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ yadi vā kāyasaṅkhāro yadi vā vacīsaṅkhāro yadi vā cittasaṅkhāro ti. --
mn44:17.2: Saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjantassa kho āvuso Visākha bhikkhuno paṭhamaṃ nirujjhati vacīsaṅkhāro, tato kāyasaṅkhāro, tato cittasaṅkhāro ti. --
mn44:18.1: Kathaṃ pan' ayye saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhānaṃ hotīti. --
mn44:18.2: Na kho āvuso Visākha saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahantassa bhikkhuno evaṃ hoti:
mn44:18.3: ahaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahissan-ti vā, ahaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahāmīti vā, ahaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhito ti vā,
mn44:18.4: atha khvāssa pubbe va tathā cittaṃ bhāvitaṃ hoti yan-taṃ tathattāya upanetīti. --
mn44:19.1: Saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahantassa pan' ayye bhikkhuno katame dhammā paṭhamaṃ uppajjanti, yadi vā kāyasaṅkhāro yadi vā vacīsaṅkhāro yadi vā cittasaṅkhāro ti. --
mn44:19.2: Saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahantassa kho āvuso Visākha bhikkhuno paṭhamaṃ uppajjati cittasaṅkhāro, tato kāyasaṅkhāro, tato vacīsaṅkhāro ti. --
mn44:20.1: Saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhitaṃ pan' ayye bhikkhuṃ kati phassā phusantīti. --
mn44:20.2: Saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhitaṃ kho āvuso Visākha bhikkhuṃ tayo phassā phusanti: suññato phasso, animitto phasso. appaṇihito phasso ti.
mn44:21.1: -Saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhitassa pan' ayye bhikkhuno kiṃninnaṃ cittaṃ hoti kiṃpoṇaṃ kiṃpabbhāran-ti.
mn44:21.2: -Saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhitassa kho āvuso Visākha bhikkhuno vivekaninnaṃ cittaṃ hoti vivekapoṇaṃ vivekapabbhāran-ti.
mn44:22.2: Tisso kho imā āvuso Visākha vedanā:
mn44:22.3: sukhā vedanā, dukkhā vedanā, adukkhamasukhā vedanā ti. --
mn44:23.1: Katamā pan' ayye sukhā vedanā, katamā dukkhā vedanā, katamā adukkhamasukhā vedanā ti.
mn44:23.2: -Yaṃ kho āvuso Visākha kāyikaṃ vā cetasikaṃ vā sukhaṃ sātaṃ vedayitaṃ
mn44:23.4: Yaṃ kho āvuso Visākha kāyikaṃ vā cetasikaṃ vā dukkhaṃ asātaṃ vedayitaṃ
mn44:23.6: Yaṃ kho āvuso Visākha kāyikaṃ vā cetasikaṃ vā n' eva sātaṃ nāsātaṃ vedayitaṃ
mn44:23.7: ayaṃ adukkhamasukhā vedanā ti. \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ --
mn44:24.1: Sukhā pan' ayye vedanā kiṃsukhā kiṃdukkhā, dukkhā vedanā kiṃdukkhā kiṃsukhā, adukkhamasukhā vedanā kiṃsukhā kiṃdukkhā ti. --
mn44:24.2: Sukhā kho āvuso Visākha vedanā ṭhitisukhā vipariṇāmadukkhā,
mn44:25.1: Sukhāya pan' ayye vedanāya kiṃanusayo anuseti, dukkhāya vedanāya kiṃanusayo anuseti, adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya kiṃanusayo anusetīti. --
mn44:25.2: Sukhāya kho āvuso Visākha vedanāya rāgānusayo anuseti, dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayo anuseti, adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya avijjānusayo anusetīti. --
mn44:26.1: Sabbāya nu kho ayye sukhāya vedanāya rāgānusayo anuseti, sabbāya dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayo anuseti, sabbāya adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya avijjānusayo anusetīti. --
mn44:26.2: Na kho āvuso Visākha sabbāya sukhāya vedanāya rāgānusayo anuseti, na sabbāya dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayo anuseti, na sabbāya adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya avijjānusayo anusetīti. --
mn44:27.1: Sukhāya pan' ayye vedanāya kiṃ pahātabbaṃ, dukkhāya vedanāya kiṃ pahātabbaṃ, adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya kiṃ pahātabban-ti. --
mn44:27.2: Sukhāya kho āvuso Visākha vedanāya rāgānusayo pahātabbo, dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayo pahātabbo, adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya avijjānusayo pahātabbo ti. --
mn44:28.1: Sabbāya nu kho ayye sukhāya vedanāya rāgānusayo pahātabbo, sabbāya dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayo pahātabbo, sabbāya adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya avijjānusayo pahātabbo ti. --
mn44:28.2: Na kho āvuso Visākha sabbāya sukhāya vedanāya rāgānusayo pahātabbo, na sabbāya dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayo pahātabbo, na sabbāya adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya avijjānusayo pahātabbo.
mn44:28.3: Idh' āvuso Visākha bhikkhu vivicc' eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati,
mn44:28.4: rāgan-tena pajahati, na tattha rāgānusayo anuseti.
mn44:28.5: Idh' āvuso Visākha bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn44:28.6: kuda-ssu nāmāhaṃ tad-āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharissāmi yad-ariyā etarahi āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharantīti,
mn44:28.7: iti anuttaresu vimokhesu pihaṃ upaṭṭhāpayato uppajjati pihāpaccayā domanassaṃ, \ [...
mn44:28.8: content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ paṭighantena pajahati, na tattha paṭighānusayo anuseti.
mn44:28.9: Idh' āvuso Visākha bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbe va somanassadomanassānaṃ atthagamā adukkhaṃ asukhaṃ upekhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati,
mn44:28.10: avijjan-tena pajahati, na tattha avijjānusayo anusetīti.
mn44:29.1: Sukhāya pan' ayye vedanāya kiṃ paṭibhāgo ti. --
mn44:29.2: Sukhāya kho āvuso Visākha vedanāya dukkhā vedanā paṭibhāgo ti. --
mn44:29.3: Dukkhāya pan' ayye vedanāya kiṃ paṭibhāgo ti. --
mn44:29.4: Dukkhāya kho āvuso Visākha vedanāya sukhā vedanā paṭibhāgo ti. --
mn44:29.5: Adukkhamasukhāya pan' ayye vedanāya kiṃ paṭibhāgo ti. --
mn44:29.6: Adukkhamasukhāya kho āvuso Visākha vedanāya avijjā paṭibhāgo ti. --
mn44:29.7: Avijjāya pan' ayye kiṃ paṭibhāgo ti. --
mn44:29.8: Avijjāya kho āvuso Visākha vijjā paṭibhāgo ti. --
mn44:29.9: Vijjāya pan' ayye kiṃ paṭibhāgo ti. --
mn44:29.10: Vijjāya kho āvuso Visākha vimutti paṭibhāgo ti. --
mn44:29.11: Vimuttiyā pan' ayye kiṃ paṭibhāgo ti. --
mn44:29.12: Vimuttiyā kho āvuso Visākha nibbānaṃ paṭibhāgo ti. --
mn44:29.13: Nibbānassa pan' ayye kiṃ paṭibhāgo ti.
mn44:29.14: -Accasarāvuso Visākha pañhaṃ, nāsakkhi pañhānaṃ pariyantaṃ gahetuṃ.
mn44:29.15: Nibbānogadhaṃ hi āvuso Visākha brahmacariyaṃ nibbānaparāyanaṃ nibbānapariyosānaṃ.
mn44:29.16: Ākaṅkhamāno ca tvaṃ āvuso Visākha Bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamitvā etam-atthaṃ puccheyyāsi, yathā ca te Bhagavā byākaroti tathā naṃ dhāreyyāsīti.
mn44:30.1: Atha kho Visākho upāsako Dhammadinnāya bhikkhuniyā bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāy' āsanā Dhammadinnaṃ bhikkhuniṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn44:30.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Visākho upāsako yāvatako ahosi Dhammadinnāya bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo taṃ sabbaṃ Bhagavato ārocesi.
mn44:30.3: Evaṃ vutte Bhagavā Visākhaṃ upāsakaṃ etad-avoca:
mn44:30.4: Paṇḍitā Visākha Dhammadinnā bhikkhunī, mahāpaññā Visākha Dhammadinnā bhikkhunī.
mn44:30.5: Mamañ-ce pi tvaṃ Visākha etamatthaṃ puccheyyāsi, aham-pi taṃ evam-evaṃ byākareyyaṃ yathā taṃ Dhammadinnāya bhikkhuniyā byākataṃ, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn44:30.6: eso c' ev' etassa attho, evam-etaṃ dhārehīti.
mn44:30.8: Attamano Visākho upāsako Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti. 45.
